purpose: Separate public global analysis, JCX-private strategy and internal diligence while preserving evidence, uncertainty and correction history.

visibility_levels.label: Public global atlas
visibility_levels.audience: Client leadership, partners, founders, practitioners and interested public readers.
may_include: Reviewed or explicitly attributed global market analysis.
Qualified entity and product records that pass the applicable publication gate.
Discovery-only records as visibly labeled discovery/watchlist cards, not endorsements or proven-company profiles.
Dated outcome and failure cases with source type, evidence grade, scope, denominator and caveat.
Standards and governance explanations with version, source and implementation limitation.
Regional analysis with headquarters, operating coverage, target market and verified deployment kept distinct.
Methodology, evidence legend, source trail, freshness, correction and limitation notices.
must_not_include: Unapproved JCX internal observations, form defects, vendor/account strategy, meeting scripts or private system hypotheses.
Unreviewed material claims presented as established facts.
Private contact, procurement, security, legal, customer or employee information.
Rankings, endorsements, investment recommendations or guaranteed performance claims derived from the corpus.
Client-specific implementation assumptions presented as public market facts.
required_review: Claim-level source and attribution review for material visible claims.
Caveat and date check for outcomes, funding, ownership, regulation, security and status.
Accessibility, licensing, correction and disclaimer review.

visibility_levels.label: JCX-private strategy chapter
visibility_levels.audience: Authorized JCX stakeholders and the authorized delivery/research team.
may_include: JCX-specific opportunity hypotheses and workflow maps.
Public-site observations and dated audit findings framed as observations requiring validation.
ERP/CRM/vendor signals, integration boundaries and source-of-truth hypotheses.
Jolshiri lead-to-booking, project truth, landowner/JV, procurement, progress, handover and smart-asset pilot canvases.
JCX relevance scoring, pilot gates, baseline-to-collect fields, owner/RACI and decision criteria.
Private comparisons of providers or ecosystem options, with evidence and conflicts disclosed.
must_not_include: Information that JCX has not authorized for the specific recipient or project.
Credentials, personal data, customer/landowner/employee records, sensitive legal/title/finance documents or security test details unless separately approved and protected.
Internal hypotheses stated as confirmed JCX facts.
Public publication of client defects, performance findings or vendor assessments without written approval.
required_review: Named JCX owner/approver for each private page or story.
Access control and audience check before sharing.
Clear distinction between observed, reported, inferred and unknown.
Confidentiality, privacy, security and legal review where relevant.

visibility_levels.label: Internal diligence and editorial workspace
visibility_levels.audience: Research, editorial, product and authorized implementation teams only.
may_include: Raw notes, unresolved identity/status/tier conflicts and claim-review queues.
Source access conditions, archive/hash details, excerpts, locators and licensing notes.
Security/privacy concerns, vendor diligence, procurement contacts and unpublished research.
Draft score dimensions, reviewer comments, correction intake and superseded content.
Unredacted source assertions, data-quality conflicts and internal build/debug artifacts.
must_not_include: Use of internal notes as facts without source and review state.
Credentials, secrets or unnecessary personal data in the content bundle.
required_review: Least-privilege access and periodic access review.
Retention/deletion rules appropriate to the source and sensitivity.
Human review before promotion to JCX-private or public_global.

dataset_rules.public_treatment: Use selected records after checking publication_readiness, review_flags_json, status, canonical_url_status and claim review. Nulls remain explicit.
dataset_rules.private_treatment: May support JCX opportunity and comparison work with approved access.
notes: 295 typed qualified entities are not equally publishable.
Programs, products and projects must not be counted as organizations.

dataset_rules.public_treatment: Search/discovery frontier of 978 identities; display evidence_stage, discovery_only, source layers and snapshot date.
dataset_rules.private_treatment: May support diligence and promotion decisions.
notes: 683 discovery-only identities are not proven companies.
Directory and ecosystem membership is not deployment, traction, security or outcome evidence.

dataset_rules.public_treatment: Only reviewed claims or explicitly attributed provisional claims with source, claim grade, caveat and date.
dataset_rules.private_treatment: May be used for JCX analysis when the review state is visible.
notes: All 834 claims currently require claim-level editorial review.
public_use values are gates, not optional labels.

dataset_rules.public_treatment: Expose only resolved/approved values or an uncertainty explanation; do not expose raw conflicting values as a public scalar.
dataset_rules.private_treatment: Use for audit, conflict explanation and correction workflow.
notes: 3,896 assertions preserve source observations and disagreements.

dataset_rules.public_treatment: Show only with relationship type, status, source and date; distinguish membership, ownership, acquisition, product-of, implementation and partnership.
dataset_rules.private_treatment: Use unresolved relationship review for diligence.
notes: A reported/program relationship is not deployment or outcome proof.

dataset_rules.public_treatment: Use as bounded evidence packets with baseline, intervention, metric, period/sample, source type, outcome grade, causal caveat and transferability.
dataset_rules.private_treatment: May inform JCX pilot hypotheses, never forecasts without JCX baseline data.
notes: 44 cases: 40 B3, 2 B2 and 2 A1 under the case-library convention.
Do not aggregate unlike units into a universal ROI score.

dataset_rules.public_treatment: Show domain, version/status, problem solved, JCX implication and lock-in/implementation caveat.
dataset_rules.private_treatment: Use for architecture and vendor acceptance criteria.
notes: 39 standards/frameworks are reference records, not proof of vendor implementation or compliance.

dataset_rules.public_treatment: Expose source identity, URL, title/publisher/date where reviewed, source quality, claim linkage, access/license notes and retrieval date as appropriate.
dataset_rules.private_treatment: Full lineage and access conditions available to authorized reviewers.
notes: 1,600 normalized sources; source quality remains provisional/domain-level and is not claim verification.

dataset_rules.public_treatment: Dated snapshot with YC status, batch, profile and explicit discovery caveat.
dataset_rules.private_treatment: Use for candidate diligence and promotion.
notes: YC selection/status does not establish product maturity, revenue, deployment, security or ROI.

dataset_rules.public_treatment: Show ecosystem membership as discovery signal with source page, capture date and status note.
dataset_rules.private_treatment: Use source-row provenance for diligence and identity review.
notes: 683 ecosystem pairs resolve to 653 linked identities; the pair count is not a company count.

exceptions: Sections describing JCX-specific strategy, private implementation observations or unpublished client material require jcx_private or internal_only handling.
Treat proposed IA and visual/editorial direction as constraints and methodology, not a mandatory visual design.
Individual public-source facts may be promoted only after source/caveat review and JCX approval.
Public benchmarks and general venture-client concepts may be separately rewritten for public_global; account-entry strategy and internal recommendations remain private.
Use only to explain current quality controls; do not expose historical defects as current facts without context.
Public methodology may summarize the PASS state and remaining editorial queue without exposing internal-only notes.

field_rules.public_condition: reviewed or explicitly attributed with claim grade, source, date, limitation and public_use approval
field_rules.private_condition: may remain provisional if review status and source trail are visible
field_rules.internal_default: raw assertion, reviewer note or unresolved conflict

field_rules.public_condition: current status and observation date shown; event date used only when sourced
field_rules.private_condition: status conflict and unresolved source evidence may be shown to authorized users
field_rules.internal_default: raw or contradictory status assertions before review

field_rules.public_condition: reviewed snapshot with rubric version, rationale, confidence and unknown dimensions
field_rules.private_condition: provisional JCX scoring may be used for authorized decisions
field_rules.internal_default: draft score dimensions and reviewer deliberation

field_rules.public_condition: identity resolution, alias/parent/product/acquisition relationship and source are reviewed or visibly unresolved
field_rules.private_condition: collision candidates and relationship review queue may be shown
field_rules.internal_default: raw matching evidence, source-row notes and merge/split deliberation

field_rules.public_condition: never expose personal, financial, identity, precise location/safety or confidential client data
field_rules.private_condition: only minimum necessary, consented/authorized data under applicable controls

universal_constraints: Unknown is not zero, failure or a neutral score; preserve typed missingness.
Do not expose private JCX content through search, indexing, previews, source drawers, generated summaries or chart data.
Do not use a shared domain, directory listing, accelerator membership or customer logo as identity, ownership, deployment or outcome proof.
Do not present company/vendor/customer-reported metrics as independently verified or as JCX forecasts.
Do not convert legacy A–D, A1/B2/B3 or other source-layer labels into S1–S5/C1–C5 automatically.
Do not publish legal, privacy, finance, title, safety, engineering or cybersecurity conclusions as advice; route them to qualified review.
Preserve correction, supersession and source history; do not silently overwrite a prior statement.
Promotion between visibility levels requires a named reviewer/approver and an auditable reason.
